record.name: Chile
record.summary: No qualifying institute identified. The AI bill in the Senate would give enforcement to the data protection agency, with an advisory council at the science ministry. In Aug 2026 the science ministry announced a new bill to replace it.

partial.scope: Negative-status confidence, preserved query provenance, national/official-language search coverage and source-independence audit; this is not a full recheck of all record fields.
Reassessed negative confidence under the revised rule using saved research. No retained English query. No new search or full recheck.
Attempted preservation of cited source copies and checked saved-copy hashes; failures remain in source access notes. This source-evidence work is not a full factual recheck of the record.

English searches for a national AI safety, security or evaluation institute, commitment, proposal or study. English results concern the AI bill, data-protection enforcement, advisory governance and public-sector AI support. The cached Senate article assigns enforcement and sanctions to the data-protection agency and proposes an advisory technical council; it does not designate an institute to evaluate advanced models. No new institute-specific government proposal or study was identified. Partial check only; the last full-check date is unchanged.

News search from 17 October 2026 in English and Spanish, with the science ministry's news listing (newest 9 November). No qualifying item was found. Negotiations with OpenAI reported by Diario Financiero have an undisclosed scope, and the token, training and adoption plans reported by Periodismo2 and Diario Financiero name no advanced-model evaluator. Any later signed agreement was not found. Partial check, not a full record re-check.

check.language_note: The recorded es query uses a national or official language selected for this country-specific check. Other national or official languages were not exhaustively searched. Search source_ids identify registered source URLs matched in the retrieved result set, which may include irrelevant hits. An empty list means no registered source URL was matched, not that the web response was empty. The earlier audit used independent_source_ids for substantive corroboration; governance_source_ids, where present, identifies the selected primary governance evidence. English queries were also run on 17 October 2026; the previously recorded national or official-language coverage and its limits are unchanged.
check.independence_note: Historical audit under the superseded two-independent-sources rule: Two substantively independent evidence origins were not established. Multiple pages from one owner, mirrors, reports of the same underlying announcement and general regional coverage are not counted as independent corroboration.
check.governance_note: The Senate account describes proposed AI regulation and enforcement responsibilities for the data-protection agency; legislative proposals remain distinct from enacted governance.

related_bodies.name: Consejo Asesor Técnico de IA (proposed, Ministry of Science)
related_bodies.role: It would propose lists of high-risk systems and review the law. It would be an advisory body under the Senate bill, with no model evaluation mandate.

related_bodies.name: Agencia de Protección de Datos Personales
related_bodies.role: It would hold inspection and sanction powers under the bill; it would be a regulator, not an evaluation institute.

record.notes: The Ministry of Science announced in Aug 2026 a replacement bill and a state AI laboratory to support ministries and municipalities; neither was described as evaluating models.
